title: Agent Toolbox
idiom: Shaker-plain linocut, a row of nearly empty tool totes
hero_prompt: Black-and-cream linocut print in a plain Shaker spirit, hand-made on paper, flat and graphic with visible carved ink texture, not a photograph, not a 3D render, no depth-of-field: a long plain workbench holding a row of small open wooden carpenter's totes, each tote carrying only two or three tools and nothing more: one a hammer and a chisel, one a paintbrush and a palette knife, one a single pair of scissors, one a small spirit level. Lots of empty space around each tote, a bare pegboard wall behind with simple tool outlines painted on it, most of them empty.
icon_prompt: Linocut emblem, a flat single-colour black silhouette on a warm ochre ground, no shading or gradients: a single open wooden tote box seen from the side, holding just a hammer and a wrench standing upright in it. Bold, high-contrast, no fine linework, reads clearly at 24 pixels.
